purpose: 同一产品的三个连续页面，逐张生成，不是三个备选风格。
brief: 2026-10-04 光集 macOS 原生素材工作台。用户要求先用 Image Gen 输出同一产品 UI 组图，每次一张。延续已选 Lightroom/Photos 工作台方向，更新为 macOS 27，深色协调侧栏、扁平布局、仅少量系统玻璃控件、专业单素材时间线。三张连续页面：照片调色、视频与 Live 制作、混合素材浏览多选。概念图，不代表功能全部已实现。

screens.name: 调色工作台
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create one realistic, production-quality native macOS 27 desktop application UI screenshot for a photography and Live Photo editing app named 光集. This is the PHOTO COLOR GRADING screen of a coherent three-screen product series. Only ONE full-screen app view in this image, NOT a collage, not multiple options, no presentation board, no device bezel, no desktop wallpaper or perspective. Target dimensions 1600 x 1000, sharp legible Chinese UI typography, realistic SF Pro / PingFang sans-serif, scale appropriate to a real Mac app.

Input images: reference 1 is a PREVIOUS selected product mock showing the desired photography-first workflow and imagery, not the desired light theme; reference 2 is the CURRENT native prototype and identifies product structure, but its stiff spacing and coarse controls need improvement. References are grounding and not edit targets. Deliberately redesign chrome into a flatter, calmer, more refined professional workstation. Maintain a photography-first layout inspired by Lightroom and Apple Photos with macOS 27 native design conventions.

VISUAL SYSTEM: cohesive warm-neutral dark gray sidebars on BOTH sides; no white sidebar, no mismatched white/black split. Left sidebar approx 180px wide in #252523, right inspector approx 285px wide in #242422, near-black neutral viewer. A single muted olive-gold accent #b9a477 only for selection/primary action. macOS native unified title toolbar with standard three traffic lights, elegant SF Symbol style thin icons. Subtle native translucent glass only on small toolbar action clusters and the viewer comparison button; solid calm reading surfaces for all dense controls. No decorative gradients, no neon, no technology blue-purple, no big floating boxes, no dashboard cards, no nested outlined rectangles, no rounded box around every slider/section. Align labels, ample breathing space, clean section headings, hairline dividers only where useful. Dense but readable inspector; typography mostly 13-15px, smaller metadata still comfortably legible.

FOCUSED COMPOSITION: broad large central photograph filling most available viewer area: a gorgeous realistic Alpine lake at golden hour, dark forest, mountain peaks and subtle cloud glow; luminous natural highlights, rich photographic detail, not oversaturated. Simple native top title bar displays 光集 at left, current name 湖畔日落.HEIC near the middle with small HDR status. A minimal Browse/Edit native pill reads 浏览 and 编辑 with 编辑 active. Top right before/after icon, inspector icon, and ONE primary export action 导出. Avoid extra feature inventory.

LEFT: neat flat navigation: 图库, 收藏, 最近导入; compact 来源 header with iPhone, Pocket 3, Micro SD; small selection highlight. Lower portion shows a selected source thumbnail and concise camera metadata 4032 × 3024, HEIC, HDR. No giant counts, fake stats, slogans, AI panels or chat.

RIGHT: flat inspector top tabs 调色 / 画面 / 声音, 调色 active with a fine olive underline. A realistic small RGB histogram integrated directly into the inspector surface (no framed card). Header 创意 LUT with subtle circled i icon, 3 genuinely image-based little LUT previews showing same mountain scene labeled 原色 / 暖调 / 柔和, 暖调 selected with thin olive indication. A slim strength track with small precise thumb and value 60%. Heading 光线 with small i: rows 曝光 +0.2, 高光 −18, 阴影 +12; thin 2px slider lines, 7px circular knobs, editable numeric values aligned right, no control boxes. Heading 色彩 with small i: 色温 5600, 色调 +6, 饱和度 +8. Terminology explanation should be represented only by the quiet i buttons, no verbose lessons or colored info card. Bottom has a quiet reset arrow icon, not a large boxed reset button.

VIEWER: bottom-right small icon-only comparison control, like Apple Photos before/after; no big 原片/调色 segmented pill. Viewer top small restrained HDR indicator.
BOTTOM: tidy horizontal filmstrip of 5 realistic related lake, forest, coast, Live and video thumbnails, with photos/video/Live glyphs and 3 selected items indicated with a subtle olive outline and small check. Flat footer 已选 3 项 on left and a small action 同步调色… on right. This is a photo editing view, not a video timeline: avoid a fake playback bar here.

Hierarchy and spacing must communicate: photograph first, inspector second, navigation third. One cohesive application, beautiful and plausible, not a feature-inventory poster. Exact short Chinese strings where supplied. Current date anchor 2026-10-04 if any dates appear, but preferably no dates. No explanatory labels outside the actual app, no watermark.

screens.name: 视频与 Live
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE production-quality native macOS 27 UI screenshot, the VIDEO AND LIVE PHOTO CREATION page of 光集. Target 1600 x 1000. The attached image is the exact visual-system reference from the previous PHOTO GRADING screen of the SAME product. Keep identical toolbar geometry, typography, sidebar proportions, muted olive-gold accent, quiet warm dark-gray surfaces, thin SF Symbol style icons, restrained macOS native translucent toolbar material. Preserve a consistent sibling page, not a new design direction. Only one app view, no collage, no device bezel, no wallpaper, no marketing labels, no watermark.

Maintain photography-first professionalism combining the clarity of Final Cut Pro's viewer/timeline and Lightroom's calm inspector. Left and right panels harmonious warm charcoal (no white left sidebar), near-black canvas. No cards inside cards, no box around each setting, no colored feature inventory, no neon, no blue-purple UI chrome, no decorative gradients. Short Chinese strings, sharp clear PingFang/SF Pro typography. Primary action is 制作 Live; supporting actions can be 导出视频 and 设为封面. Glass is only a subtle native effect on small toolbar controls, never over whole inspector or timeline.

TOP unified Mac toolbar: native three traffic lights, 光集 at left, DJI_0142.MOV centered with small HDR badge, 浏览 / 编辑 with 编辑 active. Right icon-only before/after and inspector toggles, understated 导出视频. Same height and rhythm as reference.
LEFT: same flat navigation 图库 / 收藏 / 最近导入 and 来源: iPhone / DJI Pocket 3 / Micro SD, Micro SD selected. Selected media thumbnail lower; concise metadata 3840 × 2160, 29.97 fps, 00:38.40, HEVC. No long instructional text.
MAIN VIEWER: large beautiful natural moving-video still of the SAME sunset Alpine lake and mountain scene family as the reference: rippling water in foreground, warm sun skimming distant peaks, forest reflected in water. Real photographic detail and natural highlights, not saturated paint. Viewer takes most width; compact icon-only before/after control bottom-right, small HDR 原片 badge top-right. Keep generous clear viewing area.

RIGHT inspector top tabs 调色 / 画面 / 声音, 声音 selected using same fine gold underline. Flat section 原声 with small speaker mute icon, elegant slim horizontal volume slider, value 0%, secondary short text 已静音. Next section 背景音乐 with circled i, chosen music 山间微风.m4a displayed as a plain row with a small music note and remove x, volume 35%, tiny precise track, and sparse controls 淡入 0.3 s / 淡出 0.5 s as compact unobtrusive numeric rows. No fake giant audio charts. Next flat section Live 片段 with circled i; values 时长 3.00 s and 封面 00:13.40, one quiet 选取 3 秒 action. Beneath, a small informational i affordance for Live specification; no lecture paragraph and no info card. A single clear warm-gold primary button 制作 Live in lower inspector, with understated 原片保留 beneath. This is a CONCEPT design, waveform/audio fades can be conceptual, do not insert 'prototype' text inside UI.

PROFESSIONAL LOWER TIMELINE, approximately bottom 230px beneath viewer only, pure near-black:
- Compact transport toolbar: previous frame / play / next frame icon buttons, clear monospaced source current time 00:13.82 / 00:38.40, right a small zoom-control icon and 设为封面.
- A clearly spaced source-time ruler above video thumbnails. Zoomed editing range 00:11.00 through 00:16.00, with 0.5 second subdivisions and legible tick marks.
- One continuous strip of actual visually distinct frames of lake ripples as a VIDEO CLIP OBJECT, not many boxed cards. Gold trim handles at exactly 00:12.00 and 00:15.00, thin gold top/bottom range indication, outside-range frames dimmed.
- A single THIN WHITE PLAYHEAD at 00:13.82 crossing ruler and tracks, tiny white triangular head. A SEPARATE small GOLD DIAMOND cover marker at 00:13.40 with unobtrusive label 封面 13.40. These must be different positions and visual semantics, not confused with the trim handles.
- Beneath video strip, one subtle muted olive-gray BGM track strip with a plausible thin audio waveform and 山间微风 label, aligned to selected 3-second range. It is a genuine track object, not a big decorative music card.
- Small bottom metadata row 入 12.00   出 15.00 at left and 3.00 s at right.
DO NOT use a plain giant rounded progress slider; DO NOT add 2 independent start/end sliders in the inspector; DO NOT add multi-track editing complexity, animation tracks or AI chat.
Do not show a second media filmstrip beneath the timeline in this page; keep the focused Live workflow spacious. Match visual continuity of the provided reference exactly while improving the hierarchy for video. If any dates appear anchor to 2026-10-04, preferably no dates.
screens.refinement:
Edit this existing 光集 VIDEO / LIVE macOS interface screenshot. Preserve all photography, application geometry, sidebar, title toolbar, colors, typography, inspector tabs, timeline positions, waveform, trim handles, cover marker and playhead exactly. Make ONLY these three small corrections:
1. In the right inspector, remove the two-line instruction paragraph above the gold 制作 Live button (the paragraph currently starts 将视频片段制作成 Live Photo and contains a duration range). Remove the separate circled i attached to that paragraph too. Leave clean negative space there; do not replace it with new explanatory text. Keep the circled i next to the Live 片段 section heading.
2. Directly below the gold 制作 Live button, replace the CHECKBOX before 原片保留 with a small thin passive LOCK icon. It is an informational status, never a checkbox. Keep the words 原片保留 and subdued styling, no extra box.
3. The top-right 导出视频 button should be subdued charcoal, not gold. Keep its label, dimensions and location. The right inspector 制作 Live button remains the single gold primary action.
Do not change anything else. One screenshot, same size and ratio, flat macOS dark UI, no surrounding presentation or watermark.

screens.name: 素材浏览与多选
screens.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE production-quality realistic native macOS 27 UI screenshot, the MATERIAL LIBRARY AND MIXED SELECTION page of 光集. Target 1600 x 1000. The attached image is the SAME app's photo color-grading page, the exact visual-system and imagery reference. This is a coherent sibling page, not a new visual option. Keep identical app typography, toolbar height, dark warm neutral grays, quiet olive-gold accent, thin SF Symbol icons, harmonious dark sidebars on both sides, subtle native glass only on toolbar control groups. Photographic imagery should echo the beautiful alpine lake, mountains, forest and coast from the reference. One single app view only, no collage, device bezel, desktop wallpaper, marketing text, perspective or watermark.

Design a focused primary screen, not a feature inventory. The goal is browse mixed photo/video/Live media, select three, inspect sources, then open editing. Main content is a clean Apple Photos-style PHOTO GRID. Minimal chrome, no card mosaic masquerading as dashboard, no graphs, no counters for analytics, no empty placeholder images, no colored feature panels, no AI chat. The photographic media tiles are legitimate media objects; they have no outer card shells, shadows, large rounding or captions inside big boxes. Use spacing and typography first, tiny dividers only as needed.

NATIVE TITLE TOOLBAR: traffic lights and 光集 on left. Central 浏览 / 编辑 native segment with 浏览 active. Right quiet search icon/short search field 搜索素材 and a single olive-gold primary action 编辑所选. No secondary bright export action.

LEFT approx 190px: 图库 selected, 收藏, 最近导入. 来源 header with iPhone, DJI Pocket 3, Micro SD. A few small album names below: 山湖之旅, 海岸日落, 日常. Flat sidebar items, semibold selection in a muted charcoal native row, no row cards, no giant counts.

CENTER approx 1110px: heading 山湖之旅 with quiet subtitle 照片、视频与 Live. Above grid a minimal flat toolbar 全部 / 照片 / 视频 / Live (全部 active), a small sort 最近拍摄 and grid-size glyph. Do not box the whole grid in a panel.
A neatly spaced 4-column x 3-row media grid, each tile approximately 230 x 160, center-cropped natural photography, with tiny 8px gaps. Real varied travel imagery: sunset alpine lake matching reference, forest trail, snow peaks, sunlit rippling lake water, seaside cliffs, a candid cat near shore, white wildflowers, lakeside cabin, mist forest, pebble beach, sailing boat, warm mountain sunrise. All plausible personal camera images, not repeated identical assets. Three tiles selected: one image, one video, one Live. Selected tiles have a THIN muted-gold outline and small discrete round check at corner, not giant shaded overlays. Videos get small video glyph plus 00:38 or 00:12 bottom-left. Live gets subtle native Live icon and LIVE bottom-left. A small source-stack badge 2 个位置 on the selected video indicates the same logical asset is found on two devices; never show 'delete duplicate'. Under each tile only a compact filename in clear small text, no large info block.
Bottom flat selection bar: 已选 3 项 · 1 张照片 / 1 段视频 / 1 张 Live; supporting 同步调色… action, understated, not another big CTA. Main app content balanced to fill viewport naturally without a massive empty region.

RIGHT approx 270px, same flat dark inspector surface as reference, heading 所选素材:
A compact row of the three selected thumbnails, without nested cards.
Simple label-value rows 类型 混合素材, 数量 3 项, 色彩 HDR / SDR.
A flat 来源 section with small circled i: show the selected video name DJI_0142.MOV and two logical source locations as short readable rows with device glyphs:
Micro SD · /DCIM/100MEDIA
iPhone · /旅行/山湖之旅
A quiet small line 同一素材 · 2 个位置. This is a unified logical media item with separate paths, not a destructive merge. Avoid extensive filesystem dumps and error/warning cards.
Below, simple metadata for focused video 3840 × 2160, 29.97 fps, HEVC.
Bottom restrained text 原片保留 with a passive lock icon, NOT a checkbox because originals always remain untouched.

All UI body typography primarily 13–15px, concise Chinese labels, consistent reference's PingFang/SF Pro, no serifs, no emoji (standard Mac traffic lights and simple system icons only). Base backgrounds pure near-black and solid charcoal; no technology blue-purple chrome or gradients. Let the photography provide visual variety. This is a concept screen for product planning. If dates are needed use October 4 2026 as anchor; prefer no dates. Output only the full screen UI, no external explanatory captions.

note: 设计概念含规划功能；图中范围、模型文案和参数不构成技术规格。
